description: Capture a screenshot of Zotero. Can capture the main window, a specific window, or a specific element by CSS selector. Optionally highlight an element with a red border.

highlightSelector.description: CSS selector for element to highlight with red border before capture

selector.description: CSS selector for element to capture (required if target='element')

target.description: What to capture: main-window (default), specific window, or element

windowId.description: Window outerWindowID (use zotero_list_windows to find). Required if target='window'

name: zotero_screenshot
